entity_disease.rule: MONDO non-obsolete, non-grouping, descendant of MONDO:0700096 (human disease or disorder)

entity_drug.rule: maximumClinicalStage == 'APPROVAL', with an APPROVAL-stage indication on the molecule or its parent, not a vaccine component, collapsed to the ChEMBL parent

entity_pathway_names.rule: Reactome id -> name, all pathways mentioned by ot_target

entity_gene.rule: targets of the approved drugs, plus genes with curated disease evidence (relation #3)

entity_pathway.rule: Reactome pathways of the gene reference set

post_cutoff_set.rule: entities of the post-cutoff approval set (notebook 07, Part II)
